title: Don't Get Sacked By A Bad Decision
description: Thinking of driving after a few? Think again. Bad decisions happen fast, but the consequences last.#superbowl #SantaMonica
transcript_text: Super Bowl's going to be so fun on Sunday. >> How are we getting home after the game? >> Only have a couple of drinks. I can drive. >> [snorts] >> Oh, she didn't see that one coming. Don't fumble your future. That's what happens when you don't plan ahead. Bad decisions happen fast, you know. There's no replay in life. Everybody have a safe Super Bowl Sunday.
